pages.title: Sharpness and Gathering
pages.text: Sharpness: +1% weapon damage per layer.$(br2)Spirit Gathering: +1% personal Qi regeneration per layer while the weapon is held.

pages.title: Devouring and Flight
pages.text: Spirit Devouring: attacks drain 0.01% of the target's maximum Qi per layer.$(br2)Swift Flight: +0.1% flying-weapon speed per layer.

pages.title: Sturdy and Storage
pages.text: Sturdy: +1% maximum weapon durability per layer.$(br2)Qi Storage: +1% safe injected-Qi capacity per layer.

pages.title: Armor Breaking
pages.text: Armor Breaking: +1% damage per layer when the target is wearing armor.$(br2)Restrictions of the same type stack. Restrictions merged during evolution still contribute to the final effect.

pages.title: Armor Restrictions
pages.text: Insert armor or clothing to see defensive restrictions only. Protection reduces incoming damage by 0.25% per layer. Fire Ward, Blast Ward, Arrow Ward and Light Fall reduce matching damage by 0.5% per layer. Worn pieces stack, capped at 80% total reduction. Sturdy and Spirit Gathering also work on armor. Cosmetic slots do not count.
